# CI / Deployment Checklist: Foundation & Scaffolding

**Purpose**: Validate that continuous integration, release-gate, and deployment requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable for the baseline pipeline established in this phase.
**Created**: 2026-09-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the CI pipeline stages (build, test, security) each enumerated as explicit requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the set of workflows needed beyond the baseline (build, test, security, evaluation, deploy-test, deploy-prod, rollback) documented as in-scope or deferred? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it specified that the pipeline must run on *every* branch *and* every pull request as separate triggering events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the requirement that a failed check fails the run and surfaces the failure to the developer documented? [Completeness, Spec §US3 Acceptance Scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the relationship between the baseline CI pipeline and the governed release gates (constitution/RUNBOOK) documented as a requirement or explicit deferral? [Completeness, Spec §US3, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Are CI requirements defined for both the backend and the frontend repositories as applicable, including any shared workflow layout? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, plan.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "baseline CI pipeline" distinguished unambiguously from the full/future release pipeline in the requirements? [Clarity, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the meaning of "security validation" in FR-007 defined (e.g., dependency scan, SAST, secret detection) rather than left generic? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it clear which event types (push/branch/PR) are included and which are excluded (e.g., tags, manual triggers)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the acceptance thresholds for "completes without failure" defined quantitatively (exit codes, stage success), or is the criterion left ambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the state after a partially staged run (e.g., build passes but security fails) described in the requirements? [Clarity, Spec §US3, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Does the CI trigger requirement (every branch and PR) align consistently between FR-007, SC-004, and the US3 acceptance scenario? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007/SC-004/US3]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the CI stages in the requirements consistent with the documented workflow listing in plan.md (build.yml, test.yml, security.yml)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, plan.md]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the scope boundary consistent—baseline CI included but production deployment explicitly out of scope—across all sections? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the security-related workflow requirements align with the SECURITY.md Secure Delivery Gates and the constitution's release-gate governance? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, SECURITY.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Is the SC-004 acceptance criterion measurable (a CI run passing build, test, and security stages on a branch and a PR)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the US3 acceptance outcome objectively verifiable by triggering a CI run, without reference to implementation details? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US3 Independent Test]
- [ ] CHK018 Are acceptance criteria defined for the failure path—a run that fails a check being marked failed and visible to the developer—rather than only the success path? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US3 Acceptance Scenario 2]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for the primary scenario (a committed change triggers build + test + security on a branch/PR)? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for the alternate scenario where a change fails one stage and the run is marked failed? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK021 Are non-functional coverage requirements present for CI performance/duration (e.g., time bounds on a run) or is this intentionally deferred? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Is it specified whether the baseline CI includes deployment of artifacts, or only build/test/security validation? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Is the requirement defined for two CI runs targeting the same schema concurrently (from the listed edge case)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for CI behavior when required environment secrets are missing during the run? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is concurrency/cancellation behavior for overlapping CI runs (e.g., latest-wins, sequential) specified in the requirements? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for migration-application failures within a CI/verification context (partial failure path)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 Is a CI run-duration/performance requirement quantified, or is it explicitly out of scope for the baseline? [Non-Functional, Spec §NFR, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Are security requirements for the CI workflows themselves (no secrets in logs, secret injection from store) specified? [Security, Spec §FR-005, SECURITY.md]
- [ ] CHK029 Is a rollback/deployment requirement defined for the baseline, or clearly deferred to later phases? [Deployment, Spec §Assumptions, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for how the CI pipeline protects the release gates described in the constitution/RUNBOOK? [Governance, Spec §US3, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 Is the assumption that CI runs on every branch and every pull request explicitly recorded and validated? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK032 Are external dependencies of the CI pipeline (CI hosting, container registry, secret store) documented as requirements or assumptions? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the assumption that this phase only establishes a *baseline* pipeline (maturing later) recorded without contradiction? [Assumption, Spec §US3]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK034 Is the term "security validation" free of ambiguity across all pipeline-related sections? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK035 Is "every branch and pull request" free of ambiguity regarding which branch types are covered? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK036 Is there any unresolved conflict between the baseline-CI-in-scope requirement and the production-deployment-out-of-scope assumption? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
